protocol.feature_policy: Fixed compact finance-only features; trailing windows include the completed signal session, no feature selection or ticker identity. No news inputs. Reindex to NYSE sessions before calculating lags; do not fill gaps.
protocol.price_policy: Returns, trend and labels use frozen Adj Close. Intraday range uses same-session vendor High/Low/Close; volume uses a trailing ratio. Vendor adjustments are retrieval-time, not point-in-time vintages.
protocol.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on fit rows for logistic; trees use raw ratio features. Drop rows missing any fixed feature equally for all candidates.

calibration.data: Separate immediately preceding calendar year; no validation outcomes used

protocol.direction_policy: Each candidate's displayed probability determines its direction; raw and sigmoid outputs are separately named candidates. Legacy serving labels are unchanged.
protocol.fold_source: Frozen snapshot development_folds: validation 2022, 2023, 2024, with five-session outcome purging at every segment end
protocol.selection: Lowest equal-year mean validation Brier loss across all six model outputs AND the three baselines. Exact ties prefer baseline, then logistic, hist_boost, xgboost; raw before sigmoid. No threshold search, early-stopping search, extra seeds or additional fits after viewing results.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular date-block bootstrap separately within each validation year; retain all tickers on sampled dates; average year gains
uncertainty.limitations: Exploratory, conditional on fitted models, not multiplicity-adjusted and not a post-selection guarantee

protocol.holdout_policy: Read only development CSVs; do not read or score 2025 candidate holdout regardless of prior-use answer during this experiment.
protocol.promotion_policy: Never overwrite serving models or promote from these reused development years. Freeze a later cost-aware strategy and confirm unused holdout before final evaluation.
limitations: Retrieval-time adjusted data can be revised
Finance-only comparison does not test sentiment
Prediction metrics do not establish profitable trading
